cards.meaning: weave To interlace threads or combine different elements.

cards.title: A garden worth growing.
cards.text: When a storm damaged Leo’s garden, he stayed resilient. He planted new seeds and gave them gentle care. With steady effort, flowers began to bloom. Soon, curious neighbors stopped to help. To Leo’s delight, the garden became a place where strangers shared stories and friendships grew.
cards.meaning: resilient Able to recover and adapt after difficulty.
